title: Misty
notes: AABA, 32 bars, written by a pianist and it shows: the A section is a chain of ii-Vs that sits well under two hands. Bar 7 | Gm7 C7 | is sometimes written | Ebmaj7 | or | Cm7 F7 |. The bridge bars 21-22 are written Am7 and D7 over two bars; many charts compress them to | Am7 D7 |, which leaves room for | Abmaj7 | in bar 23.
